_about: Garathorm School House (levels 1-6): a gentle place. The schoolmaster and teachers, pupils, the janitor, a fencing master who spars with any who ask (an elite, never the first to strike), a schoolyard bully, and rats in the outhouse.

51700.name: schoolmaster
51700.long_desc: The schoolmaster sits behind his desk, peering over his spectacles.
51700.description: Thin, stern and ink-fingered, with a cane he has never once used and a voice that has silenced five hundred pupils.

51701.name: pupil
51701.long_desc: A pupil scratches sums on a slate, tongue between teeth.
51701.description: A child of Garathorm in a patched smock, chalk on the cuffs and mischief in the eyes.

51702.name: janitor
51702.long_desc: The janitor leans on his broom, muttering about muddy boots.
51702.description: A wiry old man with a ring of keys at his belt that opens every door in the building.

51703.name: fencing master
51703.long_desc: The fencing master salutes you with his foil, inviting a bout.
51703.description: Upright, silver-haired and quick as a cat. He was the champion of the city once, and he still teaches the young which end of the sword to hold.

51704.name: rat outhouse
51704.long_desc: An outhouse rat squeaks indignantly at you.

51705.name: pony school
51705.long_desc: The school's pony munches hay in its stall.
51705.description: A shaggy, patient pony that has carried a generation of children around the yard.

51706.name: bully schoolyard
51706.long_desc: A schoolyard bully lounges behind the school house, cracking his knuckles.
51706.description: A big lad for his age with a split lip and a chip on his shoulder. He picks on anyone smaller, and on anyone who looks at him.

51707.name: teacher
51707.long_desc: A teacher chalks a lesson onto the board.
51707.description: Patient, tired and fond of the pupils, with chalk dust in the hair.
